findings.summary: packed_sheet_end_scale accumulates the radial magnitude from |radial_value| (the dS/dradius return) while packed_sheet_field builds B_R at tiledassembly.py:671 from gamma_value (dS/dgamma), so the B_R half of the matrix is divided by a quantity that is not the sum of the terms that make up that entry; measured over 207 sloped WEST pairs the scale used runs 0.44x to 6.4e4x the true term sum (median 4.8x), so B_R errors are understated by up to four orders of magnitude.

the gate the node reports as closed does not reproduce on CPU: the same named test at NOVA_SHEET_TILE_TARGETS=32 NOVA_SHEET_TILE_WORKERS=1 gives worst entry 1.089e-08 with 6835 of 217088 entries above 1e-13 (p99=5.041e-12, p99.9=6.494e-10), against the recorded 2.083e-15 and zero on titan, so the 1e-13 agreement is a property of one backend's code generation rather than of the implementation, and the measure is unmet on the platform the default lane runs and the repository's own tests use.

REFERENCE_GATE was widened from 1e-8 to 1e-6 after the first run of the independent check failed at 3.052e-08 (titan-gate-xfail-run.log); the three-order convergence at 3.0518099689e-8 / 3.0518099493e-8 / 3.0518099360e-8 does justify a formulation-gap bound, but the change is a tolerance relaxation made to turn a red check green and it is recorded only in a code comment and the fragment.

packed_sheet_end_scale re-states the endpoint swap, slope, flat selection and per-component scaling of packed_sheet_field (tiledassembly.py:649-683) instead of factoring those steps, so the two branch structures can drift apart, and did: the radial term of the new function no longer matches the component it is supposed to scale.

the docstring of test_west_mesh_is_the_prototype_mesh keeps the plan reference 'the plan measures on' in a file this node edited and whose module docstring it scrubbed of its section reference, so the same file now enforces the rule in one place and breaks it in another.

VERDICT goal: the node goal is to re-measure the sheet tile against the fixed sheet route with the per-end tolerance; the landed change does re-measure and removes the strict xfail, but the B_R half is measured against a denominator that is not the per-end term sum, at nova/biot/tiledassembly.py:723.
VERDICT done_when: the done_when's three clauses: the gate is asserted at tests/test_sheet_tile.py:314 against a scale built at nova/biot/tiledassembly.py:723 (wrong term for B_R, and it reproduces only on titan); the slow marks are in place at tests/test_sheet_tile.py:257 and :291; the reversed-normal control is red with its own test id and EXIT=1 in negative-control.log.
VERDICT write_paths: the manifest declares five write paths and the diff touches three of them - nova/biot/tiledassembly.py, tests/test_sheet_tile.py, docs/evidence/fragments/iron-core-magnetisation/icm-sheet-tile-measure.html - with nothing outside the fence.
VERDICT manifest: read; it states the gate result, the control's failing test id and EXIT=1, both suite arms with revision, command and EXIT=0, and its own rubric self-check lines.
VERDICT diff: read commit by commit over the eight commits 66622b944..36ef6849b against base 57a72ac96: the abs() port in _sheet_arsinh_rule and the phi mirroring in _sheet_arsinh_gradient, the new packed_sheet_end_scale, the ring reference test and the evidence fragment, 395 insertions over three files.
CALL_SITES: none
SCORE goal_fidelity: 11
JUSTIFICATION goal_fidelity: nova/biot/tiledassembly.py:723 divides the B_R half by a magnitude drawn from the wrong derivative, so the re-measurement the goal names covers only the B_Z half.
SCORE evidence: 8
JUSTIFICATION evidence: the logged titan result at titan-gate.log:6 does not reproduce on CPU, where tests/test_sheet_tile.py:314 gives worst 1.089e-08 with 6835 entries above 1e-13 at 32 targets.
SCORE scope_discipline: 18
JUSTIFICATION scope_discipline: git diff 57a72ac96 36ef6849b --stat touches only the three declared paths, with no plan edit and no peer path.
SCORE durability: 8
JUSTIFICATION durability: the reversed-normal control reddens tests/test_sheet_tile.py:314 as the negative-control log shows, but no assertion covers the scale built at nova/biot/tiledassembly.py:686, which is why the wrong B_R term passes.
SCORE fit: 15
JUSTIFICATION fit: the new function follows the xp-first idiom of nova/biot/tiledassembly.py:633 and its docstring states the mechanism, but tests/test_sheet_tile.py:250 keeps a plan reference in a file the node otherwise scrubbed.
SCORE reuse: 14
JUSTIFICATION reuse: packed_sheet_end_scale reuses _sheet_closed_gradient and _sheet_pancake_terms, and a search of nova/, scripts/ and tests/ for end_scale, absolute_contribut and per-end found no prior owner, but it restates the branch scaffold of packed_sheet_field at nova/biot/tiledassembly.py:649-683.
FINDING nova/biot/tiledassembly.py:723 blocking: the radial per-end magnitude is taken from radial_value (dS/dradius) while packed_sheet_field builds B_R at tiledassembly.py:671 from gamma_value (dS/dgamma), so the B_R denominator is not the sum of the terms that make up the entry; measured over 207 sloped WEST pairs the scale used runs 0.44x to 6.4e4x the true term sum (median 4.8x), understating B_R error by up to four orders of magnitude.
FINDING tests/test_sheet_tile.py:314 blocking: the recorded gate does not reproduce on CPU - the same named test at NOVA_SHEET_TILE_TARGETS=32 NOVA_SHEET_TILE_WORKERS=1 gives worst 1.089e-08 with 6835 of 217088 entries above 1e-13 against the recorded 2.083e-15 and zero, so the 1e-13 agreement is backend-specific and unmet on the platform the default lane runs.
FINDING tests/test_sheet_tile.py:79 non-blocking: REFERENCE_GATE was widened from 1e-8 to 1e-6 after the first run failed at 3.052e-08; the convergence data justifies a formulation-gap bound, but the relaxation is recorded only in a code comment and the fragment.
FINDING nova/biot/tiledassembly.py:686 non-blocking: packed_sheet_end_scale restates the endpoint swap, slope, flat selection and scaling of packed_sheet_field at tiledassembly.py:649-683 rather than factoring them, and the two branch structures have already drifted.
FINDING tests/test_sheet_tile.py:250 non-blocking: a plan reference ('the plan measures on') survives in the docstring of a file this node edited and otherwise scrubbed of exactly that kind of reference.
